literal_facts: August 10 issuer report identifies ongoing AMD second-deployment construction at Rockdale, distinct from completed initial deployment.
Participant motion defines Riot Facility at 2721 Charles Martin Hall Road; Riot's issuer account confirms the same Rhodium-to-Whinstone transaction within its Rockdale facility.
Exact official TxGIO/CSEC address record matches that facility street address.
campus_association.analyst_reconciliation: Participant-defined facility address plus issuer same-campus identity binds the source address point to one Rockdale campus. It does not locate a particular new AMD building or imply every existing building is under construction.

distinctness_review.method: All selected names and stable keys reviewed. Full-geometry Shapely 2.1.2 intersects() comparison with every selected feature, including holes.
distinctness_review.preservation: Existing campus key retained. Initial AMD retrofit is completed and stays unselected; new project key describes only the second AMD deployment, phases 3 and 4. All old sources remain byte-preserved. One campus across all phases, mining buildings and acquired Rhodium constituents.

successor_review.finding: Initial AMD deployment completed; second deployment explicitly under construction on August 10 with future November 2026/May 2027 targets. No exact expansion completion/cancellation successor found in bounded official index and campus searches.
successor_review.scope_caveat: Undated campus operational label refers to pre-existing infrastructure, not a dated completion of the selected new expansion.
